sentences.text: The Eurotas or Evrotas -LRB- Greek : Ευρώτας -RRB- is the main river of Laconia and one of the major rivers of the Peloponnese , in Greece .	Peloponnese	Peloponnese	Greece	Greece	Laconia	Laconia
The river 's springs are located just northwest of the border between Laconia and Arcadia , at Skortsinos .	Arcadia	Arcadia	Laconia	Laconia	Skortsinos	Skortsinos

The river is also fed by underwater springs at Pellana and by tributaries coursing down from Mt. Taygetos and Mt. Parnon , which flank the Eurotas valley to the west and east , respectively .	Pellana	Pellana	Mt. Taygetos	Taygetos	Mt. Parnon	Parnon
The river is 82 km long , flowing in a north-south direction and emptying into the Laconian Gulf .	Laconian Gulf	Laconian Gulf

causal_questions.question: Eurotas (river) is a minor river of Laconia.
